about: Singapore land outline from the URA Master Plan 2014 subzone boundaries with the URA SDCP Waterbody polygons (reservoirs, rivers, Marina Bay) cut out of it; both from data.gov.sg and contain information licensed under the Singapore Open Data Licence v1.0, the subzones via github.com/yinshanyang/singapore. Water narrower than about 60 m (drains) is left out. Simplified to about 1 m around Marina Bay and the centre and about 7 m elsewhere. Holes are water; draw with the even-odd rule.
